title: Grandhjørnet fire concept at zoning level (Brannkonsept reguleringsnivå), Sarpsborg
jurisdiction: Norway, Sarpsborg kommune (planning-announcement folder dated 2024-07-16). Client Grand Terrasse AS. Comparative only, not Alberta.
code_edition: TEK17 (Teknisk forskrift 2017) with VTEK17 (dynamic edition, Dec 2017) stated (p. 2)

facts.text: Cover: client Grand Terrasse AS; document F_RA_01, version B03, dated 2023-02-08; 'Kvartal 62 B – Grandhjørnet'.
Summary: Norconsult AS engaged by Grand Terrasse AS for a fire concept at zoning (reguleringsplan) level.
States that TEK17 with guidance VTEK17 is applied.
Fire class per building depends on the number of storeys, which the report calls an important premise.
Escape-route text: at least two independent escape routes, or one exit with two alternative directions leading to independent escape routes or safe places (translated).
Requires at least 5.0 m of shielding from the fire cell toward the escape route, by facade or by fire-separating walls.
Refers to a 'brannteknisk situasjonsplan' and 'brannskisser' (fire site plan and fire sketches) for detail.
Notes that, per the drawing basis, several apartments are not through-apartments facing the street.
Section 4 is a planning-level checklist described as a control document for designers at plan level.
